item.title: Co-packaged optics roadmap targets 1.6T links for AI clusters
item.description: Vendors outlined co-packaged optics modules that move optical engines closer to switch ASICs. The roadmap focuses on 1.6T links, lower picojoules per bit, and denser AI training clusters.

item.title: New liquid cooling design cuts accelerator rack power overhead
item.description: A data center operator described a liquid cooling loop that reduces fan energy and stabilizes GPU racks. The design targets higher rack density without raising power usage effectiveness.

item.title: Optical switch fabric lowers tail latency in scale-out training networks
item.description: The switch fabric combines circuit switching with packet scheduling for east-west AI traffic. Tests show lower tail latency for distributed training jobs and reduced congestion on spine links.
